auth.signInTitle: Sign in or create an account
auth.signInIntro: Enter your email and we’ll send you a one-time code. No password to remember.
auth.codeIntro: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in a few minutes.
auth.verifyBody: Your email address isn’t verified yet, so we can’t open your account. Use the code or link we sent you, or sign in again.
auth.disabledBody: Contact us if you think that is a mistake.
auth.notConfigured: Sign-in isn’t set up on this site yet. Choose a backend and set its variables (docs/choosing-a-backend.md).
auth.devNotice: Development sign-in is on: any email works, the code is 000000.
auth.linkFailed: That sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new code.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: It’s been recorded. Trying again often works; if it keeps happening, send us the reference below.
errors.bodyArea: The rest of the app is fine. Try again, or go back and carry on; the error has been reported.
errors.notFoundBody: That page doesn’t exist or was moved.
